column1: # The critical distinction the ACT requires: "a function that reads a
# pointer as a container of immutable values" vs "a function whose
# behavior depends on pointer identity".  Column 07 records that verdict.

column14: Reads only tok->tk_type and tok->i64 (2 scalar fields). The Lexeme POINTER is a container of immutable values; the decision never depends on WHICH Lexeme it is.
Production body delegates to BootstrapCalcPadding; the legacy C body is confined to the #else branch.
READ: cls_field->type->size. WRITE: `type->offset = offset;` at src/parser.c:424 -- mutates a host-owned AstType node in place. The write is what makes the function identity-sensitive.

Hypothetical size-only sub-slice. Would read type->size only. But the offset side effect is interleaved in the SAME loop, so extracting a pure sub-slice would duplicate the alignment walk and could not be delegated without the offset it must not compute. No production call site.
Reads cls_field->type->size through the List as an immutable container. Writes only to a LOCAL `int max`. No host-graph mutation whatsoever.
Reads c->kind, c->type->kind, c->i64. NULL-safe. No writes.
Recursive read-only walk of s->kind, s->stms, s->then, s->els.
Recursive read-only walk; also reads s->forcond, s->forbody, s->whilecond, s->whilebody, s->case_default.
Reads text->data and text->len. The bytes are immutable for the duration of the call.
malloc(sizeof(ClsField)); stores the two host pointers into the fresh record.
static int id; incremented per call. This IS identity/state sensitive across calls: NOT reproducible.
READ: anon->fields map iteration; base->offset. WRITE: `type->offset += offset;` and mapAdd(fields_dict, ...). Mutates both the AstType graph and the host Map.
Mutates the cc token ring via cctrlTokenGet; writes *kind_out and *reg_out.
Result node carries `lit->type = astTypeCopy(dst)` -- a host AstType pointer is embedded in the returned AST, so the result is not a bounded value projection.
Owns jmp_buf; installs into cc->current_recovery; appends to body->stms; mutates cc->localenv / cc->tmp_locals / cc->tmp_case_list.
Mutates cc->localenv (registers the declared variable); consumes the token ring.
Rewinds the token stream (cctrlRewindUntilStrMatch); owns the diagnostic raise.
